The Japanese has a term for this: 積ん読 (Tsundoku), i.e the habit of buying books and letting them pile up unread. A list of books I will need to finish at some points.
In essence, an antilibrary is a collection of unread books. It represents an ode to self that reminds you about topics that one wants to explore.Anne-Laure Le Cunff
